climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A 7,800 acre canyon in the center of the Santa Ynez Valley in Santa Barbara County, between Los Olivos, Ballard and Solvang.
